unit.why: Mainly a homily from Zera Kodesh (R. Naftali of Ropshitz) on Deut. 22:8–9, about building the Temple through hidden worship. It embeds only a brief reported vision of R. Elimelech during a soul-ascent, plus his saying about R. Yaakov Yitzhak of Łańcut.

stories.start_quote: וכן שמעתי מהרב הקדוש מוה׳ אלימלך זצ״ל
stories.end_quote: מתפילת מנחה מפיל כל מה שבונים
stories.summary_en: R. Elimelech, during an ascent of the soul, saw the Temple vessels being carried and was told they were the ones he had brought out of exile. He also said that R. Yaakov Yitzhak of Łańcut's Minhah prayer knocks down a great house of impurity that thousands of builders put up each day.
